aboutGame.title: About Fruit Zombie Survival
paragraphs: Fruit Zombie Survival is a Roblox wave-survival experience by Vibed Games. This wiki is organized around the decisions players make before and during a run: check rewards, learn the first survival loop, test fruit powers, pair them with builds, and avoid treating old update notes as permanent truth.

Use Codes before a session, Start Here during your first runs, Fruits and Builds when a power path feels weak, Diamonds and Berries when you are deciding where to spend effort, and Elite Waves when regular wave advice stops being enough. Each page keeps volatile claims dated so new players can separate confirmed Roblox facts from reported guide coverage.

diamonds-and-berries.overviewDescription: Berries are officially tied to powering up during a run. Diamond farming has strong video demand, but exact rates and best routes need page-level evidence before publication.

fruits.overviewDescription: The official source confirms 20 collectible fruits. Publish beginner choice guidance conservatively until fruit names, powers, unlocks, and comparisons have entity-level evidence.

updates.overviewDescription: Roblox evidence currently supports an Artifacts title prefix and a September 12, 2026 API update timestamp; code and guide claims must be rechecked when these signals change.
